messages:
tariq (PM): heads-up: we're validating compare table micro interactions before design review next week. key focuses: filter overflow, compare sticky header behavior on scroll, and pin discoverability. sketch: https://figma.com/file/ghi789

anya (Design): small tweak: sticky header should compress (smaller padding) on scroll so more rows remain visible. also considering a subtle divider when sticky to indicate separation.

felix (Frontend): we can animate header compression with `max-height` and `transform` for perf. care with mobile where sticky + virtualized list can be tricky.

ria (A11y): ensure header changes maintain semantic order and don't confuse keyboard users. the compressed header should still be reachable via tab.

harper (Infra): note: pin state toggles call an API. debounce rapid toggles client-side to avoid spamming the service. we'll accept batched updates (one request per 2s).

tariq (PM): filter overflow: current mock wraps chips and the compare action bar jumps. prefer a single-line chip row + overflow menu.

anya (Design): agreed. add a subtle hint `+3 more` that opens the menu. design to show count and a keyboard shortcut hint.

felix (Frontend): will implement ellipsis + `+N` button. will attach prototype link.

ria (A11y): `+N` needs `aria-haspopup` and `aria-expanded`. also ensure focus order when opening moves into menu.

anya (Design): pin discoverability: propose an animated pulse for unpinned rows after first load (one-time per session) that points to the pin rail. subtle, not annoying.

felix (Frontend): can do, but keep animation prefers-reduced-motion friendly. add `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` fallback.

harper (Infra): server side: nothing to change. we track telemetry for pin events. tariq: add experiment flag if we want to A/B test the pulse.

tariq (PM): will do. action items: felix prototype for chip overflow and header compression; anya update figma with pulse microcopy; ria draft a11y checklist; harper add experiment flag. sync Mon 9am PT.

felix (Frontend): prototype: https://intranet/proto/compare-chips-193200 (WIP). will post updates here.
